checklist.notes: The completed-past timeline, movement sense of run, and coherent help exchange directly realize simple time reference and requesting help.
Meaning/form explanation, sense clarification, two-role model, pronunciation practice, and an integrated checklist provide usable self-study stages.
The lesson draws only on its reconstructed prior present-simple and phoneme knowledge while introducing all four allocated targets in a sensible order.
The timeline, one-sense definition, dialogue, clap counts, and final success conditions are concrete and comprehensible at A1.2.
Four targets are present, but each is tightly limited to one form, one sense, one request exchange, and a short syllable/final-cluster focus.
The Vietnamese name, practical transit context, and explicit no-extra-vowel cue address likely usefulness without assuming a uniform learner deficit.
The event and help scenario connect the main targets, though writing and listening are less explicitly enacted than the metadata suggests.

findings.description: Writing is declared but no stage explicitly requires written production, and listening is limited to rehearsing both roles rather than an explicit playback/comprehension step.
findings.recommendation: Add a short instruction to write the retell and record/replay the two-role exchange before applying the existing final checks; this needs no forbidden content.

methods: Inspected the lesson against its reconstructed, hash-matched M5 teaching payload and confirmed that no external source payload was supplied.
Compared wording and examples across the closed set of all ten revised lessons for suspicious verbatim duplication beyond shared instructional scaffolding.
Reviewed the audit provenance/copyright result and source-scope constraints as machine evidence without treating them as a web-wide originality check.
copyright_originality_check.scope_limitations: Closed-corpus review of the ten supplied lessons plus their exact M5/request/audit context only; no Internet-wide search, external proprietary corpus, legal opinion, or provider receipt was available.

limitations: This is an independent AI pedagogical review for development evidence only; it is not human review, release approval, certification, or publication authorization.
The governing M5 snapshot retains DRAFT taxonomy and OUTLINE_ONLY curriculum records and is limited to the development lane.
No learner trial, classroom observation, or outcome study was performed.
No audio was supplied, so no acoustic, listening-performance, or pronunciation-performance review was performed.
Originality checking was closed-corpus and artifact-bound; no web-wide plagiarism search, external corpus comparison, or legal determination was performed.
Generation provider provenance was not independently established; UNKNOWN is retained rather than inferred.
Generator reasoning, self-assessment, and prior review records were not inspected.
response.sha256 hashes the canonical UTF-8 JSON of the decision, checklist, findings, copyright_originality_check, and limitations captured in this session.
